mapper.sql: SELECT o.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.batch_enabled, m.serial_enabled, b.version AS bom_version, w.name AS warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name FROM mes_work_order o JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = o.material_id LEFT JOIN mes_bom b ON b.id = o.bom_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = o.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = o.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT o.plan_end AS "date", 'WO' AS "type", o.wo_no AS "docNo", o.qty - o.finished_qty AS "qty" FROM mes_work_order o WHERE o.material_id = #{materialId} AND o.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND o.qty > o.finished_qty AND (o.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} OR o.warehouse_id IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT o.plan_start AS "date", 'WM' AS "type", o.wo_no AS "docNo", -(m.required_qty - m.issued_qty) AS "qty" FROM mes_wo_material m JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = m.wo_id WHERE m.material_id = #{materialId} AND o.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND m.required_qty > m.issued_qty

SELECT t.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(t.qty) AS "qty" FROM ( SELECT o.material_id, o.qty - o.finished_qty AS qty FROM mes_work_order o WHERE o.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND o.qty > o.finished_qty AND o.material_id IN #{id} UNION ALL SELECT m.material_id, -(m.required_qty - m.issued_qty) AS qty FROM mes_wo_material m JOIN mes_work_order o ON o.id = m.wo_id WHERE o.status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND m.required_qty > m.issued_qty AND m.material_id IN #{id} ) t GROUP BY t.material_id

SELECT m.id AS "materialId", COALESCE(p.supply_type, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mes_bom b WHERE b.material_id = m.id AND b.is_default = 1) THEN 'MAKE' ELSE 'BUY' END) AS "supplyType" FROM wms_material m LEFT JOIN mes_material_plan p ON p.material_id = m.id WHERE m.id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE mes_work_order SET status = 'COMPLETED', finish_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND finished_qty >= qty
UPDATE mes_work_order SET finished_qty = finished_qty + #{qty}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND finished_qty + #{qty} <= qty
